channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about JaMychal Green | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about JaMychal Green from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on JaMychal Green, Draymond Green
item.description:
“You just don’t know. I reminded him that JK had some DNPs early this season. It’s tough. But things can change quickly, and you always have to stay ready. “I would love to get him out there, but right now, JaMychal is playing really well. Obviously, we’ve gone to a smaller lineup, so that Loon and Draymond are not playing together as much. It creates a little bit of a logjam at that position. James just has to stay ready.”

Steve Kerr on JaMychal Green, Draymond Green, Jan 30, 2023. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Steve Kerr on JaMychal Green
item.description:
Steve Kerr on JaMychal Green's mysterious lower right leg infection:

“My understanding is that our training staff isn’t concerned long-term, but something that has to be remedied and serious enough to take him to the hospital and have it addressed.”

Steve Kerr on JaMychal Green, Jan 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @CjHolmes22.

item.title: Steve Kerr on JaMychal Green
item.description:
CJ Holmes:Kerr:

“I love JaMychal (Green). I didn't realize how good he was until I coached him.”

Steve Kerr on JaMychal Green, Oct 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @CjHolmes22.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on JaMychal Green
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic on JaMychal Green:

“I said one time he's a guy I wish I could play with for the rest of my life. Because he's a winner. He's not going to quit. He's a really strong guy who's going to give you a lot on the floor. I cannot be mad at him because I know he's going 100%”

Nikola Jokic on JaMychal Green, Dec 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Monty Williams on Paul Millsap, JaMychal Green, Dario Saric
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on Dario Saric minutes:

“We just felt like Dario gives us a little bit of know-how against JaMychal Green and Paul Millsap.”

Monty Williams on Paul Millsap, JaMychal Green, Dario Saric, Jun 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on JaMychal Green
item.description:
Michael Singer:Michael Malone, asked by @Adam Mares about the chemistry between JaMychal Green and Nikola Jokic:

“I don't think it's limited to Nikola. I think JaMychal Green has the respect of the entire locker room. It's his approach. It's his toughness.”

Nikola Jokic on JaMychal Green, Jan 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on JaMychal Green
item.description:
Green once again had a solid game with the Nuggets, where he produced 15 points (5-10 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 2-2 FT) and nine rebounds across 28 minutes in Thursday’s 114-104 win over the Golden State Warriors.

“I’ve always said JaMychal is a guy I’d like to play with for the rest of my life. He is amazing,”

Nikola Jokic on JaMychal Green, Jan 16, 2021. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Michael Malone on JaMychal Green, Gary Harris, Michael Porter
item.description:
“We were without two starters tonight -- no Gary Harris, no Michael Porter. I don't think we have been whole the whole year. JaMychal Green was out early, Michael Porter has been out with COVID, and Gary was not here due to personal reasons. I think that's one thing that will help us.”

Michael Malone on JaMychal Green, Gary Harris, Michael Porter, Jan 13, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Paul Millsap on JaMychal Green
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Paul Millsap on the JaMychal Green addition:

“I'm glad he's on my team. He's one of those power forwards you hate going up against.”

Paul Millsap on JaMychal Green, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Doc Rivers on JaMychal Green
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Asked about JaMychal Green being hobbled toward the end of Game 3, Doc Rivers says,

“It's the playoffs, JaMychal is a tough guy and obviously he's going to give it a go.”

Doc Rivers on JaMychal Green, Sep 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Steve Kerr on JaMychal Green
item.description:
The NBA rescinded the double tech on Kevin Durant and JaMychal Green from Game 3.Steve Kerr:

“I think the league did a good job of recognizing both Kevin and JaMychal were incredulous. Because they were actually laughing,they were talking a little trash.”

Steve Kerr on JaMychal Green, Apr 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Garrett Temple, JaMychal Green
item.description:
Frank continued,

“Garrett is respected throughout the NBA as a veteran leader and a versatile defender. JaMychal is a high-energy big who has become an excellent outside shooter. We welcome both players to the Clippers and feel they will fit well with this group.”

Lawrence Frank on Garrett Temple, JaMychal Green, Feb 7, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: David Fizdale on JaMychal Green
item.description:
In Fizdale’s mind, this led to the most critical part of camp:Randolph encouraging Green to fulfill the responsibilities of being a starter.

“He told JaMychal, ‘Little bro, get us off to good starts,’ and that took the weight off of us worrying about if Z-Bo was pissed off,”

David Fizdale on JaMychal Green, Apr 3, 2017. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: David Fizdale on JaMychal Green
item.description:
Fizdale told The Vertical.

“I’ve actually held JaMychal back a little bit, because I feel he has some ability to score more. Finding him some touches can be tough because of all the options we have, but he’s been invaluable. His ability to make open threes, defend multiple positions, loyal, being tough. He’s diligent about being in shape and working on his game, a fantastic complement to our group.”

David Fizdale on JaMychal Green, Apr 3, 2017. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Chris Wallace on JaMychal Green
item.description:
“Before first coming to Memphis, JaMychal was the top prospect in the NBA Development League, and he has impressed us both in games and in practice during his tenure with the Grizzlies,”

Chris Wallace on JaMychal Green, Mar 2, 2015. Source: NBA.com.
